evidence: Named defendant: N.C. Supreme Court held its water/sewer impact fees for future service, charged at subdivision plat approval, were not authorized (Quality Built Homes Inc. v. Town of Carthage, 369 N.C. 15, decided 2016-08-19). The Jan 2015 EFC connection-fee table lists only a $1,000 water and $1,000 sewer tap fee for Carthage (no separate capacity charge), so the EFC table does not capture plat-stage impact fees.
